meta.name: respond-compromised-account
meta.description: Respond to a potentially compromised user account. Use when impossible travel, credential stuffing, successful phishing, or suspicious activity indicates account compromise. Investigates activity, contains the account, removes persistence, and restores access.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调查并恢复被入侵的用户账号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果发现用户账号有异常活动需要立即处理
copy.tagline_en: Investigate and recover compromised user accounts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to respond to suspicious account activity and restore access

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 PICERL 模型处理用户账户泄露事件：调查可疑活动、遏制账户、移除攻击者留下的持久化机制，最后恢复账户安全。
howto.when: 当用户报告账户可能被盗，或出现异常登录、撞库攻击、钓鱼成功等迹象时触发。

say.text: 我的账户可能被盗，请调查并遏制。
say.note: 启动完整的泄露响应流程。

say.text: 检查用户张三是否有异地登录或转发规则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the PICERL model to respond to compromised user accounts: investigates suspicious activity, contains the account, removes attacker persistence, and restores access.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user reports a potentially compromised account, or when signs like impossible travel, credential stuffing, successful phishing, or suspicious activity indicate compromise.

say_en.text: My account may be compromised—investigate and contain it.
Check user john for unusual logins or forwarding rules.
